L266: 
L267: CougUV is based off the torpedo, a simple foward motion autonomous underwater vehicle.
L268: 
L269: Action Space
L270: 
L271: Has two possible action spaces, as follows:
L272:   1. Fins & Propeller: `[left_fin, top_fin, right_fin, bottom_fin, thrust]`
L273: 
L274:   2. Accelerations, in global frame: `[lin_accel_x, lin_accel_y, lin_accel_z, ang_accel_x, ang_accel_y, ang_accel_x]`
L275: 
L276: Inherits from cite10†`HoloOceanAgent` .
L277: These variables are the constants used in the C++ for “Thruster” and “PD” control schemes. Editing them in python will not change the vehicle behavior. If using the “custom dynamics” control scheme, these values are ignored, and any desired dynamics parameters must be defined separately in your dynamics implementation. Instructions for implemeting parameters for Thor Fossen dynamics are given in the corresponding fossen dynamics documentation.

L319: class holoocean.agents.FixedWing(client, name='DefaultAgent')cite9† L320: 
L321: 
L322: Fixed Wing Agent
L323: 
L324: This agent is a WIP and is currently just a copy of the Hovering AUV agent. It is not yet ready for public use.
L325: Action Space
L326: 
L327: Has three possible control schemes, as follows
L328: 
L329:   1. Thruster Forces: `[Vertical Front Starboard, Vertical Front Port, Vertical Back Port, Vertical Back Starboard, Angled Front Starboard, Angled Front Port, Angled Back Port, Angled Back Starboard]`
L330: 
L331:   2. PD Controller: `[des_pos_x, des_pos_y, des_pos_z, roll, pitch, yaw]`
L332: 
L333:   3. Accelerations, in global frame: `[lin_accel_x, lin_accel_y, lin_accel_z, ang_accel_x, ang_accel_y, ang_accel_x]`
L334: 
L335: Inherits from cite10†`HoloOceanAgent` .
L336: These variables are the constants used in the C++ for “Thruster” and “PD” control schemes. Editing them in python will not change the vehicle behavior. If using the “custom dynamics” control scheme, these values are ignored, and any desired dynamics parameters must be defined separately in your dynamics implementation. Instructions for implemeting parameters for Thor Fossen dynamics are given in the corresponding fossen dynamics documentation.
L337: The following parameters are defined in the C++ code and are not used in the python code. They are provided here for convenience in implementing custom dynamics. :cvar mass: (`float`): Mass of the vehicle in kg. :cvar water_density: (`float`): Water density in kg / m^3. :cvar volume: (`float`): Volume of vehicle in m^3. :cvar cob: (`np.ndarray`): 3-vecter Center of buoyancy from the center of mass in m. :cvar I: (`np.ndarray`): 3x3 Inertia matrix.
L338: :cvar thruster_d: (`np.ndarray`): 8x3 matrix of unit vectors in the direction of thruster propulsion :cvar thruster_p: (`np.ndarray`): 8x3 matrix of positions in local frame of thrusters positions in m.
